sourceContext.publicationRepair: Presentation references were shallow-copied on first attempt and caused roundtrip assertion failure before publication; regenerated from independent dictionaries and verified exact reconstruction.

decisions: Keep all nine slots semantically independent; the bug line itself expresses labor, the falcon line identifies only a female falcon, and the bridge-purpose line carries gathering without shifting agency to the friends.
The present tense in Защо работиш? supplies present-time framing and rhetorical necessity implicitly under the pinned literary autonomy; it does not add a command to stop.
За другарски сбор is a purpose phrase. It denotes a gathering of friends without female-only дружки; the first-person collective and scene determine whose friends.

Другари, нектар retains plural friends and the good drink through a poetic nectar metaphor, without choosing an alcohol type. мен remains singular in both poem quotations; нас remains plural only in Violet's proposed correction.

Keep all27 assembled texts and original three named/24 mixed outcomes. Some mixed compositions sound incidentally coherent, just as the source can; original identity evaluation must not be rewritten to reward them.

All saved poem lines were directly read; vowel counts are corroborating scansion, not automated semantic acceptance. Native pronunciation/readability and later independent literary review remain pending.
